answer: Because the pearl deposit is held in the quartz escrow, the ocean audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
